title.value: Improving Text-to-Image Consistency via Automatic Prompt Optimization
title.justification: The title is explicitly stated at the beginning of the paper, and it encapsulates the core research focus of the study, which is optimizing prompts to improve text-to-image consistency.
title.quote: Improving Text-to-Image Consistency via Automatic Prompt Optimization

analysis.description: This paper introduces OPT2I, a text-to-image optimization-by-prompting framework that uses large language models to improve prompt-image consistency in text-to-image generation. The framework generates and iteratively refines prompts to maximize consistency, validated by performance improvements on MSCOCO and PartiPrompts datasets, without compromising image quality or diversity.
